description: Summarize text (article, transcript, report) into a given number of sentences, via Claude Haiku 4.5. Preserves the source text's language. JSON body: {text: string (max 8000 chars), max_sentences?: integer 1-10 (default 3)}. Costs $0.01 via x402 (USDC).

max_sentences.description: Maximum number of sentences in the summary (1-10, default 3).

name: post_api_ai_summarize
